# Migration fixtures

`65.36.transit` is a fresh graph generated by Master's compiled ClojureScript
at commit `a615af70f71a280a63bc8acf4b630fb9699e916a`. It contains only built-in
data, no user pages. The fixture preserves Master's seeded value UUIDs instead
of constructing expected identities with the OCaml implementation under test.

Generation expression, with `datascript.core` as `d`,
`logseq.db.frontend.schema` as `schema`, `logseq.db.sqlite.create-graph` as
`create-graph`, and `logseq.db` as `ldb`:

```clojure
(let [conn (d/create-conn schema/schema)]
  (d/transact! conn (create-graph/build-db-initial-data ""))
  (ldb/write-transit-str @conn))
```
